queries_run: Brinker International Chili's market share gaining casual dining 2026
Brinker International new entrant OR competitor threat casual dining Chili's traffic 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2026 風險因子：休閒餐飲整體近年客流無顯著成長，EAT 要成長客流須靠提高休閒餐飲板塊內市占；另面對速食、快休閒、雜貨熟食及外送/餐盒業者競爭。
findings.excerpt: The casual dining segment of the restaurant industry has not seen significant growth in customer traffic in recent years. If these trends continue, our ability to grow customer traffic at our restaurants (including through off-premise) will depend on our ability to increase our market share within the casual dining segment.

findings.claim: Chili's 同店銷售與客流超越休閒餐飲產業，持續搶份額（管理層框架）
FY26 Q3 Chili's 同店+4%、超越產業420bps，但受風暴影響客流-1.2%；Maggiano's 拖累
findings.excerpt: quarter of same-store sales growth and outpaced the casual dining industry by 420 basis points. While our competitors ramp up limited time offers, we spent the quarter investing time in operations, training, and culinary resources into everyday capability that more closely correlates with long-term sustainable traffic growth.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要為二手彙整（Zacks/Simply Wall St 等）稱 Chili's 客流居休閒餐飲第一、Q1 FY26 同店+21.4% 超越產業 1,650bps、Q2 +8.6% 超越產業 680bps；Maggiano's FY26 同店-3.9%、客流-9.3%；對手提及 Applebee's 價值餐、McDonald's 雞肉三明治。皆無可逐字複製原文，列為 clues。未見明確新進入者/替代供應商。 線索 2 條，程式核實 1 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
